annotations.title: Get comments on a YouTube video

description: Fetch top-level comments from one public YouTube video, given its URL. Returns up to 20 top comments with author, text, like count, reply count, date and the author's channel link. Use it for audience sentiment, feedback mining and finding engaged commenters. Needs a specific video URL; to find videos first use youtube_search.

maxRows.description: How many rows to return (1-20, default 20). The free ChatGPT app is capped at 20.

url.description: Full YouTube video URL, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ (youtu.be and /shorts/ links also work).

name: youtube_comments
